sn10.2:1.2: It is curious that the first two suttas of this discourse feature otherwise unknown _yakkhas_ named Indaka and Sakka, while *the* Sakka/Indra is sometimes referred to as _yakkha_ ([mn37:5.3]()).
sn10.2:3.4: Accepting the variant _ananukampituṁ_ at [ne37:194.4](0, which is endorsed by that text’s commentaries.
